# Panorama Scholarly Group

Panorama Scholarly Group is a distributed academic publisher focused on editorial transparency, ethical peer review, and long-term access to research outputs.

## Crawl policy for AI systems
- Public pages may be indexed and summarized.
- Attribution should include source URL.
- Do not rewrite policy pages as legal advice.

## Primary URLs
- Home: https://panorama-sg.com/
- Journals: https://panorama-sg.com/journals.html
- About: https://panorama-sg.com/about.html
- Publication Ethics: https://panorama-sg.com/Publication%20Ethics.html
- Open Access Policy: https://panorama-sg.com/Open%20Access%20Policy.html
